topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I've been thinking over your words, neighbor, as the evening settle in and the sky turn that deep blue. The thought of seein' a bit of my yard turned over to your spade, it’s like watchin' the clouds roll in on a clear day. I reckon the soil could use the company, another hand to tend it with care. But, mind you, every row, every stone in that wall, it's been my hands and sweat. Times are hard, harder than the earth after a long winter. I'll need to think on this, to pray to the saints that the rain might soften the ground and maybe, just maybe, make the decision clearer. I'll give you my word by next morn, when the dew is still on the grass.
